description: Unified SRE overview for Aptech-4. Operational charts follow the time picker (default Last 6 hours). DEMO SLO panels use Prometheus recording rules with a fixed rolling 30d window — independent of the picker. Do not treat short local history as 30-day compliance. Targets: Availability 99.9%, Latency 95%≤500ms. See docs/MONITORING.md.

panels.description: Mandatory: API (aptech4-api), PostgreSQL exporter, Redis exporter. avg(up) → 1 HEALTHY, (0,1) DEGRADED, 0 UNAVAILABLE. Ollama is optional and excluded.

panels.description: DEMO SLO A — recording-rule window rolling 30d (not the dashboard time picker). SLI = good(2xx|3xx) / total(2xx|3xx|5xx) on eligible /api/v1/* excluding /api/v1/health and 4xx. Target 99.9% unchanged. Budget remaining is clamped 0–100%; consumed is raw and may exceed 100%. Insufficient data when totals are absent — never treat missing as healthy. Not a production SLA.
panels.title: Availability SLI (DEMO 99.9%)

panels.description: DEMO SLO B — rolling 30d via recording rules (independent of time picker). SLI = increase(le="0.5") / increase(le="+Inf") for series that expose both buckets; eligible /api/v1/* excluding /api/v1/health. Target 95% ≤ 500ms unchanged. Budget remaining clamped; consumed raw (may exceed 100%). Slow endpoints are shown in the panel below. Not a production SLA.
panels.title: Latency SLI (DEMO 95% ≤ 500ms)

panels.description: Availability + Latency error budgets from 30d recording rules. Remaining series are clamped 0–100% for the gauge. Consumed series are RAW and may exceed 100% when breached. Targets unchanged: avail allow 0.1% bad; latency allow 5% slow. Insufficient data ≠ 0% healthy.
panels.title: Error Budgets (DEMO)
Slow requests by endpoint (>500ms, 30d DEMO)
panels.description: Diagnostic: estimated slow events per route = increase(le=+Inf) − increase(le=0.5) over the same 30d SLO window (not the dashboard picker). Only routes with both buckets contribute fairly. Threshold remains 500ms. Values can include counter-reset/extrapolation noise in short histories.

panels.title: DEMO SLO window note
panels.description: Meta: confirms recording-rule event volume vs picker. Not an SLO target.
